## What's built (Project Horizons — Chapter 4 Season 1)

**Boot-up screen:** Animated Chapter 4 Season 1 boot sequence — "Project Horizons" title, loading text, and a battle bus flying across the screen before the lobby unlocks.

**Lobby:** Coins bar with level + XP progress bar, lobby music picker (3 Chapter 4 Season 1 tracks), active quests (3), map preview showing all 8 locations by name (The Citadel, Mega City, Shattered Slabs, Knotty Nets, Lonely Labs, Anvil Square, Brutal Bastion, Faulty Splits), Battle Pass buy button (950 C), Item Shop button, and a big "Drop Into Match" button.

**Modes:** 
- AI Battle Royale (35–45 AI, rest real-player slots)
- 100 Player Lobby (all real slots)

**In-game:** Vibrant Chapter 4-inspired grass/trees/houses/biomes, all 8 named locations, battle bus + skydive drop, shrinking storm, full HUD (weapon slots 1–4, ammo, rank, kills, coins), crosshair, kill feed, Victory Royale / Eliminated.

**Loot pool & weapons:** Stinger SMG, Thunder Burst SMG, Hammer AR, Ranger Shotgun, Flare Gun, Chug Cannon — spawn in chests across the map.

**Wildlife & vehicles:** Wolves, boars, chickens, crows roam the map; cars and dirt bikes spawn at locations (press E to enter/exit).

**Progression:** Complete 3 quests → 5–10 coins each. Level up → +1450 coins. Spend coins on the 950-coin Battle Pass (8 skins + 2 emotes) or the Item Shop (skins, wraps, emotes, loading screens, bundles) where price scales by favorited status (base × (1 + favored×0.15)).

## Assumptions made
- Since I can't ship Epic's copyrighted textures/models/music, everything is procedurally drawn with Chapter 4 Season 1 **names, colors, and structure** as a tribute.
- "Real players" in the lobby are represented as filled player slots (AI-controlled) to reach 100 combatants, since this is a single-player browser build.
- No external asset server needed — runs entirely offline from local files.

## Controls
WASD/Arrows move · Mouse aim · Click shoot · 1–4 switch weapon · R reload · F interact/chest · E enter/exit vehicle · Space jump · Enter open/close menu.
